alias_name.description: The name for the MinIO server alias (e.g., 'local', 'prod'). This is used in commands like 'mc ls prod/bucket'.

server_url.description: The URL of the MinIO server or S3-compatible endpoint.

access_key.description: The access key (username) for authenticating with the MinIO server.

secret_key.description: The secret key (password) for authenticating with the MinIO server.

api.description: The API signature version to use. Common values are 'S3v4' or 'S3v2'.

lookup.description: Bucket lookup style. Options are 'auto', 'dns', or 'path'.

insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification. Set to true if using self-signed certificates.

quiet.description: Disable progress bar display. Equivalent to --quiet flag.

json.description: Enable JSON lines formatted output. Equivalent to --json flag.

debug.description: Enable debug output. Equivalent to --debug flag.

no_color.description: Disable color theme. Equivalent to --no-color flag.

resolve.description: Resolve HOST[:PORT] to an IP address. Format: 'host:port=ip'. Empty string means no override.

limit_upload.description: Limit upload rate. Format: '10MiB/s', '1GiB/s'. Empty string means unlimited.

limit_download.description: Limit download rate. Format: '10MiB/s', '1GiB/s'. Empty string means unlimited.

custom_headers.description: List of custom HTTP headers to add to requests in 'key:value' format.

items.description: Placeholder for items schema. Not directly used as a scalar.
